add_locations.body:
! JO9 MOD START PLASTICS_MOB728_20261119
! Use the shared numbered mob pool. Navigation uses IDs, not page offsets.
if $args[0]='cache':
 $plastics_confirm_appearance = {gs 'jo9_plastics', 'confirm'}
 exit
end
if $args[0]='confirm':
 if $plastics_target ! 'slave' and $plastics_target ! 'assistant': exit
 if txt <= 0: exit
 if func('jo9_plastics','find',dyneval('result='+$plastics_target+"['age']"),$hair_color,txt,0) ! txt: exit
 dynamic $replace({
  $dynslave['fullimage']=$fullimage[txt]
  $dynslave['ava']=$seed_ava[txt]
  $dynslave['ava_gray']=$seed_ava_gray[txt]
  $dynslave['ava_clear']=$seed_ava_clear[txt]
  $dynslave['hairColor']=''
  dynslave_type=txt
 }, 'dyn'+'slave', $plastics_target)
 sp_txt=1
 killobj
 dynamic $replace($plastics_confirm_procedure,'dyn'+'slave',$plastics_target)
 gt 'shop_general'
end
if $args[0] ! 'find': exit
result=0
if $args[2]='': exit
local meta_type, jo9_ps_first, jo9_ps_last, jo9_ps_step, jo9_ps_i, jo9_ps_id
meta_type=0
jo9_ps_first=1
jo9_ps_step=1
if args[1]=CONST_INT['fresh_age']: meta_type=1
if args[1]=CONST_INT['young_age']: meta_type=2
if args[1]=CONST_INT['mature_age']: meta_type=3
if meta_type=0: exit
jo9_ps_last=func('jo9_mob_pool',meta_type,-1)
if args[4]<0: jo9_ps_first=jo9_ps_last & jo9_ps_last=1 & jo9_ps_step=-1
for jo9_ps_i = jo9_ps_first to jo9_ps_last step jo9_ps_step:
 jo9_ps_id=func('jo9_mob_pool',meta_type,jo9_ps_i)
 if (args[4]>0 and jo9_ps_id>args[3]) or (args[4]<0 and jo9_ps_id<args[3]) or (args[4]=0 and jo9_ps_id=args[3]):
  if $fullimage[jo9_ps_id] ! '' and seed_age[jo9_ps_id]=args[1] and instr(lcase($fullimage[jo9_ps_id]),'_'+lcase($args[2])+'_')>0:
   if func('jo9_random_stock_allowed',jo9_ps_id)=1: result=jo9_ps_id & exit
  end
 end
end
! JO9 MOD END PLASTICS_MOB728_20261119
